decisions.question: How to retain float32 UV fidelity when original chart scaling produced enormous coordinates?
decisions.choice: Compact high-distortion polygons with world-metric projections aligned to existing growth UV directions; one whole integer translation per polygon into REPEAT coordinates outside [0,1].
decisions.reason: Keeps stock UVs unquantized without corner-wise fract, extreme coordinates or altered geometry. audit-tall-d04 failed before correction; d10 passes.

decisions.question: Can source-only density establish compressed compliance?
decisions.choice: Measure all decoded triangles independently, then add margin only on actual affected source polygons.
decisions.reason: 732 and then 4226 exported faces failed despite source PASS; current d10 has zero undersampled measurable faces.

decisions.question: How should floor wear select polygons?
decisions.choice: Require non-prop polygon vertices wholly inside the 2.8 m wide walking strip, instead of selecting by centroid.
decisions.reason: CPU sheets exposed large angular wear wedges; saved material-index-only correction preserves all geometry/UVs/maps.

decisions.question: Can all compressed triangles be called nondegenerate?
decisions.choice: Disclose 4649 zero-area decoded triangles, the same as baseline; do not count these as measurable visible area.
decisions.reason: Source faces are nondegenerate, but unchanged stock position quantization collapses some thin geometry. This correction does not alter shared codecs or original geometry.

decisions.question: Can future native captures use the existing CPU image allowance?
decisions.choice: Provide exact inventory and request a separate parent storage decision before native work.
decisions.reason: This revision retains all original 48 plus 16 new images; no capture, cleanup or budget expansion is authorized here.
